exceptions_rule: Delegate installation/authentication guards to the existing freeze; no project role grant or new exception.

snapshot.source: Trusted server ports only; never request claims, filesystem, broker or logs.
snapshot.credential_scope: Explicit null token_scopes denotes a validated session; a PAT requires a nonempty list of exact permission strings and the exact project binding. Absent is not null.
snapshot.revision: Positive authoritative revision equals current revision on every use; stale/missing fails. No reusable allow cache or authorization ticket.

artifact_boundary.ownership: Committed published manifest.project_id and exact artifact_id membership in manifest.artifacts; never infer project from a path, caller or ID.
artifact_boundary.grant: Absent in central policy 1.1.0; deny for every role. Ownership validation is necessary but never sufficient for access.
artifact_boundary.path: Only descriptor.relative_path within the selected manifest is a logical selector; exact match, no prefix grant. No physical path authorization surface or new route.
artifact_boundary.physical_resolution: BC-013 resolves managed locators only after a fresh central allow; secure resolution remains independently mandatory under SPEC-005 and REQ-ARTLAYOUT-010. No I/O in this contract.
artifact_boundary.integrity: Publication, hashes, root_digest and lineage remain governed by SPEC-005; ownership input must come from the authoritative published record, not a caller-supplied manifest.

transitions.membership_grant: Only post_projects_projectid_members with project_member:create, existing target, registered role, unique membership, provenance and successful commit; MembershipChanged after commit.
transitions.membership_change_or_revoke: No published command/transition in the eight endpoints; unsupported, deny. No synthetic grant lifecycle or new route.
transitions.invalidation: Reevaluate every use after account/credential state, policy, scope or membership revision changes. An earlier allow never survives as authority.
transitions.invalid_transition: Reject via the existing freeze; no state change or success effects. Revoked/expired credentials cannot reactivate.

decision.diagnostics: Bounded reasonCode only; never echo internal path, raw credential, membership, existence detail or input. Audit actor/action/target/result/policy/correlation with ADR-055 redaction.
decision.check: authorization:check permits querying own decision, not the requested action. Unknown action => existing validation_failed; known denied action => allowed=false. Every subsequent operation rechecks server-side.
decision.http: No new route, field, status or error. Existing frozen guard order and operation-specific errors remain authoritative. This offline DTO is not an HTTP error mapper.

throttling.composition: Existing throttle_open guard is conjunctive where published; open never grants permission; limited, locked, absent evidence/authority never enables fallback. No new throttle engine, threshold or guard added to an endpoint.
